name: beUI
tagline: Animated components for React and Next.js
description: A copy-paste component set built with Motion and Tailwind CSS, distributed through the shadcn registry. Motion primitives like a magnetic button, morphing modal and macOS-style dock sit alongside iOS-style blocks (dynamic island, command palette, expandable action bar) — free, open source and MIT licensed.
